items.title: Gucci แต่งตั้ง Park Bo Gum เป็น Global Brand Ambassador คนใหม่
items.summary: Thai edition of Esquire covers Gucci's November 5 announcement naming Korean actor Park Bo Gum as its newest global brand ambassador, noting he will take part in Gucci events and campaigns under creative director Demna.

items.title: Gucci แต่งตั้ง Park Bo Gum เป็น Global Brand Ambassador
items.summary: L'Officiel Thailand reports the Park Bo Gum ambassador appointment, framing it within Gucci's broader Asian-celebrity ambassador strategy under Demna's creative direction.

items.title: Gucci ประกาศแต่งตั้ง Park Bo Gum ขึ้นแท่นโกลบอลแอมบาสซาเดอร์คนล่าสุด
items.summary: Elle Thailand situates Park Bo Gum's appointment alongside Gucci's other Asian ambassadors (Jin of BTS, aespa's NINGNING, Xiao Zhan), underlining the brand's continued reliance on Korean/Chinese star power to drive regional engagement, including in Thailand.

items.title: Park Bo Gum Resmi Ditunjuk Jadi Global Brand Ambassador Gucci
items.summary: Indonesian daily Jawa Pos publishes same-day coverage of the Park Bo Gum Gucci ambassador news, quoting his statement about wanting to explore creative director Demna's new direction for the house.

items.title: Park Bo Gum trở thành đại sứ toàn cầu của Gucci
items.summary: Vietnamese edition of Harper's Bazaar covers the ambassador appointment, noting Park quietly ended a prior partnership with Celine to join Gucci, read locally as a sign of Gucci pulling star power from rival LVMH-aligned houses.

items.title: KPDN seizes RM300,000 in suspected counterfeit clothing
items.summary: Malaysia's Ministry of Domestic Trade (KPDN) seized 468 counterfeit clothing items worth about RM292,800 from a Petaling Jaya storage unit; Gucci is named among the fake-branded goods alongside Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Balenciaga and Louis Vuitton, sold at malls for RM450-1,500 apiece.

items.title: Fan post: Gucci official Instagram reposts Park Bo Gum's W Korea cover
items.summary: Regional fan account notes Gucci's official Instagram repost of Park Bo Gum's W Korea Vol. 11 cover, commenting it strongly channels the brand's new image; typical fandom amplification circulating in SEA fan networks following the ambassador announcement.

items.title: Pantip Gucci tag -- ongoing Thai forum discussion thread
items.summary: Thai community board Pantip's Gucci tag page shows active threads reacting to Park Bo Gum's new ambassadorship alongside existing threads on Jin (BTS) and Lee Know (Stray Kids) as Gucci ambassadors, plus recurring bag-authenticity and belt-review discussions typical of the board's commerce-minded userbase.
